item.author: Tramonte's TrailPhotos (@tramontes-t-photos.bsky.social)
item.description:
Above the Spanish town of Bossost near France in the Pyrenees, what looks like an old road has become a trail that climbs up through nice woods, then breaks out into impressive views. With many ferns turning orange for late season. For #ColorADay #OrangeSunday.

#ECK #landscapephotography #hiking
